source_citation: Diggs, Lipscomb & O'Kennon (1999), Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source_name: Vicia ludoviciana subsp. leavenworthii (Torr. & A. Gray) Lassetter & C.R. Gunn

morphology_source_reported.peduncles: Flowers open before peduncle elongation; at flowering 0.5–3.5 cm long and 1/8–1/2 as long as subtending leaf; at fruit 2–8.5 cm

habitat_source_reported: Rocky, clayey or occasionally sandy prairies and roadsides
cautions: 1999 Flora treats as subspecies, inventory as variety; rank crosswalk is provisional and not a claim that every current taxonomy recognizes same rank
